title: Add tenant-scoped Prometheus compaction and Grafana cost templates with rollback-safe Terraform plan
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: On private installs we observed uneven TSDB growth across tenants and manual retention tweaking is error-prone during upgrades. This PR introduces a Terraform module and Helm/installer changes to provide tenant-scoped Prometheus compaction/retention configuration, pre-provisioned tenant-aware Grafana dashboard templates for cost and ingestion metrics, and a migration script that performs a rolling, rollback-safe compaction policy change without requiring Prometheus downtime. Motivation: reduce storage spend on large private deployments, enable predictable retention policies per-tenant, and give customers an out-of-the-box cost/ingest dashboard for tenant chargebacks. What this PR does (high level): - New terraform module: terraform/modules/prometheus/tenant_retention - Exposes compaction & retention settings per-tenant and maps to Prometheus Operator values via helm provider - Adds Grafana provisioning artifacts: dashboards/tenant_cost_template.json and provisioning/dashboards/tenant_cost_provisioning.yaml - Helm chart values: charts/observability/values-tenant-retention.yaml with sensible defaults and canned profiles (low/medium/high retention) - Installer upgrade script: installers/upgrade/tenant-retention-migrate.sh which orchestrates a canary rollout across replica sets and captures Terraform plan snapshots for rollback - Adds e2e smoke tests under tests/e2e/observability/tenant_retention_test.go - Documentation updates: docs/private/observability/tenant_retention.md Rollout plan: 1) deploy Terraform module with canary tenant subset (default: first 3 tenants) 2) run migration script which applies compaction changes to canary, waits for 48h of stable ingesters/TSDB compaction metrics, then continues across rest 3) propagate Grafana dashboard provisioning in parallel with retention rollout 4) monitor alerts/ingestion rates and allow automatic rollback on rule regression (see rollback section) Backwards compatibility: default profile mimics previous global retention and is a no-op unless operator supplies tenant_retention config. Migration & rollback: migration script takes a Terraform plan snapshot and PrometheusRule/Prometheus CRD version pin. If regression alert is triggered during rollout, the script automatically re-applies the saved Terraform snapshot and restores the previous Prometheus CRD version. Testing: unit tests for Terraform module (terraform validate + terratest harness), helm-lint and chart unit tests, e2e smoke test exercised in CI canary job. Security & privacy: no change to tenant data flows; dashboards use aggregated metrics only. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module with variables and examples - [x] Helm values and chart hooks - [x] Migration script with dry-run mode and verification - [x] Grafana dashboard template and provisioning config - [x] e2e smoke tests and CI pipeline updates - [x] Docs and upgrade notes Related: ENG-1620 (TSDB cost analysis), PM-543 (tenant chargeback MVP), SUP-7431 (support ticket for high-storage installs)

release_notes:
- Added tenant-scoped Prometheus retention & compaction Terraform module with canary rollout and rollback-safe migration script.
- Provisioned Grafana tenant cost dashboard template and provisioning config.
- Installer now supports tenant retention profiles (low/medium/high) configurable via Terraform.
- Adds e2e smoke tests and CI canary pipeline for observability upgrades.
discussion_summary: PR aims to give operators per-tenant retention control to reduce storage costs and allow safe upgrades in private installs
Approach uses Terraform module + helm provider mapping + migration script for minimal disruption
Reviewers asked for extra test coverage, hard caps on retention, and metric gating before progressing the rollout; all addressed
notes_for_ops: Migration script usage: ./tenant-retention-migrate.sh --tf-state <state> --canary-tenants tenant-a,tenant-b --dry-run to validate plan. Script will emit a terraform plan snapshot at /tmp/retention-plan-<ts>. To rollback: ./tenant-retention-migrate.sh --restore /tmp/retention-plan-<ts> --force
audits: manual-qa: performed against 3-node canary cluster; validated compaction metrics (prometheus_tsdb_head_samples_post_compaction_total) and alert stability
storage-impact: estimated 18-32% reduction for high-cardinality tenants depending on profile
notes: This PR is focused on private-installer operator workflows and is intentionally conservative: defaults preserve previous behavior until an operator opts into tenant-specific profiles. The Terraform module and helm mapping are documented with example var files for common cloud/on-prem topologies.
